async function have5RawIronIntoIronIngots(bot) {
    // This function checks if the bot possesses at least five iron ingots. If not, it determines how many more are needed and verifies if enough raw iron is available. It then searches for a suitable fuel source from a predefined list. If no furnace is nearby, it attempts to place one. Finally, it smelts the required raw iron using the chosen fuel to reach the target ingot count.
}
